kb_sentinel_wager.accept_text:
Seven scrapings off whatever walks out past the light. Not from the edge - from past it, far enough that you are the only lit thing out there.

I will tell you why, and then you can decide whether I am wasting your time. The Codex Hall's floor is cut from stone we quarried out of the Dim side. For a month it has been cold in exactly the pattern of the courses. Not the room. The STONE. I would like to know if it is still connected to where it came from.

The Dim Reaches are the unlit south-west corner of the Underdark, as far from our gate as the cavern goes.

kb_sealed_entry.accept_text:
I am going to write you into the Codex and then I am going to seal it, and you are going to supply the materials, because I am not spending the Archive's paper on a formality.

Three worked fragments from the Colonnade, three pieces of druse out of the Geode, three leaves off the thing in the Bloom - one from each of the places that made you worth the entry. And press the pages yourself. Frostpine, from the ice, the long way up.

It is ceremony. I am aware. Ceremony is what a cataloguing expedition has instead of a flag.

The Weeping Colonnade is south of our gate, the Hollow Geode east, the Deep Bloom in the south-west. You know all three by now.
